 pixset=set(pix); markset=set(marks)
 # board bounds incl marks
 if any(not(0<=r<26 and 0<=c<26) for r,c in pixset|markset): return None
 oldpix=set(); oldmarks=defaultdict(list)
 for k,t in placed.items():

 candidates=[]
